class.name: VASourceLeech
class.description: A sound source that leeches raytracing results off a parent [VAEmitter] instead of casting its own rays. Must be a direct child of a [VAEmitter] (or [VAListener]) node. Useful for sounds that fire frequently from the same location (e.g. footsteps, gunshots) without each needing its own raytraced emitter. If [member ALSource.autoplay] is [code]true[/code] and [method play] is called (including the automatic call on [code]_ready[/code]) before the parent emitter has produced any raytracing results yet, playback is deferred and starts automatically as soon as those results are available.
